G1401.def:
δοῦλος, -η, -ον, 
[in LXX, ὁ δ. nearly always for עֶבֶד; ὁ δ. chiefly for שִׁפְחָה ,אָמָה ;] 
__1. in bondage to, subject to: Romains 6:19. 
__2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ δ., a slave; 
__(a) fem., ἡ δ., a female slave, bondmaid (Cremer, 702; DB, iii, 215): Luc 1:38, 48 Actes 2:18" (LXX) ; 
__(b) masc., ὁ δ., a slave, bond-man: Matthieu 8:9 18:23, al.; opposite to ἐλεύθερος, 1 Corinthiens 7:22 12:13, Galates 3:28, Éphésiens 6:8, Colossiens 3:11, Apocalypse 6:15 13:16 19:18; opposite to κύριος, δεσπότης, οἰκοδεσπότης, Matthieu 10:24 13:27, 28 Luc 12:46, Jean 15:15, Éphésiens 6:5, Colossiens 3:22 4:1, al.; metaphorically, δ. Χριστοῦ, τοῦ Χρ., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Romains 1:1, 1 Corinthiens 7:22, Galates 1:10, Éphésiens 6:6, Philippiens 1:1, Colossiens 4:12, Jacques 1:1, 2 Pierre 1:1, Ju 1; δ. τ. θεοῦ, τ. κυρίου, Actes 16:17, 2 Timothée 2:24, Tite 1:1, 1 Pierre 2:16, Apocalypse 7:3 15:3; δ. πονηρός, ἀχρεῖος, κακός, Matthieu 18:32 24:48 25:26, 30, Luc 17:10 19:22; δ. ἁμαρτίας, Jean 8:34, Romains 6:17, 20; τ. φθορᾶς, 2 Pierre 2:19. 
SYN.: διάκονος (q.V.), θεράπων, ὐπηρέτης (see DB, iii, 377; iv, 461, 469; DCG, i, 221; ii, 613; Cremer, 215, 702).

G1402.def:
δουλόω, -ῶ
(δοῦλος), [in LXX for עָבַד ;] 
to enslave, bring into bondage: Actes 7:6 (LXX), 2 Pierre 2:19; metaphorically, 1 Corinthiens 9:19; pass., before ἐν, 1 Corinthiens 7:15; τ. θεῷ, Romains 6:22; τ. δικαιοσύνῃ, Romains 6:18; οἴνῳ, Tite 2:3; ὑπὸ τὰ στοιχεῖα τ. κόσμου, Galates 4:3 (Cremer, 217).†

G1403.def:
δοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(δέχομαι), [in LXX: Genèse 21:8, Esther 1:3, al. (מִשְׁתֶּה), Dan LXX 5:1 (לֶחֶם) ;] 
a feast, banquet: Luc 5:29 14:13.†

G1404.def:
δράκων, -ο τος, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for תַּנִּין ;] 
a dragon, a mythical monster: figuratively, of Satan, Apocalypse 12:3-17 13:2, 4 13:11 16:13 20:2.†

G1405.def:
δράσσομαι 
[in LXX for נָשַׁק pi., Psaumes 2:12; elsewhere קָמַץ, as Lévitique 2:2 ;] 
to grasp with the hand, to lay hold of: metaphorically, with accusative (M, Pr., 65), 1 Corinthiens 3:19 (LXX).†

G1406.def:
δραχμή, -ῆς, ἡ
(δράσσομαι), [in LXX: in Hex. for in בֶּקַע, שֶׁקֶל Ezra for אֲדַרְכֹּן, דַּרְכְּמוֹן ;] 
a drachma, nearly equal to the Roman denarius (see: δηνόριον): Luc 15:8-9 (DCG, ii, 200).†

G1407.def:
δρέπανον, -ου, τό
(later form of Attic δρεπάνη, δρέπω, to pluck), [in LXX for מַזְמֵדָה, חֶרְמֵשׁ, etc. ;] 
a sickle, pruning-hook; Marc 4:29, Apocalypse 14:14-19.†

G1408.def:
δρόμος, -ου, ὁ
(δραμεῖν, see: τρέχω) [in LXX chiefly for מְרוּצָה ;] 
a course: figuratively, of life or ministry, Actes 13:25 20:24, 2 Timothée 4:7.†

G1409.def:
Δρούσιλλα (Rec. Δρουσίλλα), ης, ἡ 
Drusilla, wife of Felix: Actes 24:24.†

G1410.def:
δύναμαι, depon., 
[in LXX chiefly for יָכֹל ;] 
to be able, have power, whether by personal ability, permission, or opportunity: with inf. (M, Pr., 205; WM, §44, 3) pres., Matthieu 6:24, Marc 2:7, Jean 3:2, 1 Corinthiens 10:21, al.; with inf. aor., Matthieu 3:9, Marc 1:45, Jean 3:3, 4 Romains 8:39, al.; with accusative, to be able to do something: Marc 9:22, Luc 12:26; 2 Corinthiens 13:8; absol., to be able, capable, powerful: 1 Corinthiens 3:2 10:13.

G1412.def:
δυναμόω, -ῶ
(δύναμις), [in LXX for עָזַז, Psaumes 52:7 68:28; גָּבַר pi., hi., Ecclésiaste 10:10, Da TH 9:27 * ;] 
to make strong, strengthen: Éphésiens 6:10 (WH, mg.; ἐνδυν-, WH, txt., RV), Colossiens 1:11, Hébreux 11:34.†

G1413.def:
δυνάστης, -ου, ὁ
(δύναμαι), [in LXX for גִּבּוֹר, עָרִיץ, בַּיִת, etc. ;] 
a prince, ruler, potentate: Luc 1:52; of God (Sir.46:5, 16, 2Ma.15:3), 1 Timothée 6:15; of a high official (cf. δυνάσται Φαραώ, Genèse 50:4), Actes 8:27 (Cremer, 221).†

G1414.def:
δυνατέω, -ῶ
(δυνατός), 
to be able, be powerful, mighty: with inf., Romains 14:4, 2 Corinthiens 9:8; absol., opposite to ἀσθενῶ 2 Corinthiens 13:3.†

G1415.def:
δυνατός, -ή, -όν
(δύναμαι), [in LXX for גִּבּוֹר, חַיִל, etc. ;] 
__1. strong, mighty, powerful: absol., Luc 1:49, 1 Colossiens 1:26; οἱ δ., the chief men, Actes 25:5 ; of spiritual strength, Romains 15:1, 2 Corinthiens 12:10 13:9; before ἐν, Luc 24:19, Actes 7:22 18:24; πρός, 2 Corinthiens 10:4. 
__2. C. inf., able to do; Luc 14:31, Actes 11:17, Romains 4:21 11:23, 2 Timothée 1:12, Tite 1:9, Hébreux 11:19, Jacques 3:2. 
__3. Neut., δυνατόν, possible: Matthieu 19:26, Marc 9:23 10:27 14:36, Luc 18:27, Actes 2:24 20:16; εἰ δ. (ἐστι), Matthieu 24:24 26:30, Marc 13:22 14:35, Romains 12:18, Galates 4:15; τὸ δ. (= ἡ δύναμις) αὐτοῦ, Romains 9:22.†

G1416.def:
δύνω Ion, and trag. form of δύω, 
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;] 
to enter, sink into; of the sun (sc. όντον), set: Marc 1:32, Luc 4:40 
(cf. ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπ-εν-, παρ-εισ-, ἐπι-δύνω).† 
δύω, see: δύνω 
δύνω Ion, and trag. form of δύω, 
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;] 
to enter, sink into; of the sun (sc. όντον), set: Marc 1:32, Luc 4:40 
(cf. ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπ-εν-, παρ-εισ-, ἐπι-δύνω).† 
δύω, see: δύνω

G1417.def:
δύο, numeral, indecl. exc. in dative, δυσί, δυσίν (Attic δυοῖν), 
two: Matthieu 19:6, Marc 10:8, Jean 2:6, al.; with pl. noun, Matthieu 9:27 10:10, al.; οἱ, τῶν, τοὺς δ., Matthieu 19:5 20:24, Marc 10:8, Éphésiens 2:15, al.; δ. ἐξ, Luc 24:13; distrib., ἀνὰ, κατὰ δ., two and two, two apiece: Luc 10:1 (WH, ἀνὰ δ. [δύο]), Jean 2:6, 1 Corinthiens 14:27; δύο δύο (= ἀνὰ δ., as LXX, Genèse 6:19 for שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם, but not merely "Hebraism," cf. μυρία μυρία, Æsch., Pers., 981, and for usage in π. and MGr., see M, Pr., 21, 97), Marc 6:7; εἰς δ. (two and two, Xen., Cyr., 7, 5, 17), into two parts, Matthieu 27:51, Marc 15:38.

G1419.def:
δυσ-βάστακτος, -ον
(βαστάζω), [in LXX for נֵטֶל, Proverbes 27:3 * ;] 
hard to be borne: Matthieu 23:4 (om. WH, txt., R, mg.), Luc 11:46.†

G1420.def:
δυσεντερία, -ας, ἡ, 
Rec. for δυσεντέριον (which see), Actes 28:8.†

G1422.def:
δύσκολος, -ον
(κόλον, food), [in LXX for אֵיד, Jérémie 29:9 (Jérémie 49:8) (of. δυσκολία, Job 34:30; εὔκολος, 2 Rois 15:3) * ;] 
__1. properly, of persons, hard to satisfy with food, hence, generally, hard to please (Eur., Plat.). 
__2. Of things, difficult, hard (Arist.): Marc 10:24.†

G1423.def:
δυσκόλως 
adv., 
with difficulty: Matthieu 19:23, Marc 10:23, Luc 18:24.†

G1424.def:
δυσμή, -ῆς, ἡ
(= δύσις, δύνω), [in LXX for בּוֹא, עֲרָבָה, etc. ;] 
mostly in pl., opposite to ἀνατολαί; 
__1. a setting, as of the sun (accusative to Thayer, see word, so perhaps in Luc 12:54). 
__2. the quarter of sunset, the west: anarth., Matthieu 8:11 24:27, Luc 12:54 13:29, Apocalypse 21:13.†

G1426.def:
δυσφημία, -ας, ἡ 
(δύσφημος, slanderous), [in LXX: 1Ma.7:38, 3Ma.2:20 * ;] 
evil-speaking, defamation: opposite to εὐφημία, 2 Corinthiens 6:8.†

G1427.def:
δώδεκα, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl. 
numeral, twelve: Matthieu 9:20 10:1, al.; οἱ δ., the apostles, Matthieu 10:5, Marc 4:10, al.; in Actes 19:7 24:11, for Rec. δεκαδύο.

G1429.def:
δωδεκά-φυλος, -ον
(δώδεκα, φυλή), 
of twelve tribes: as subst. neut., τό δ. (cf. λαὸς ὁ δ., Sibyll. Orac.), the twelve tribes, Actes 26:7.†

G1430.def:
δῶμα, -τος, τό
(δέμω, to build), [in LXX for גָּג ;] 
chiefly in poets and late (not Attic) prose; 
__1. a house, hall. 
__2. In LXX (and Hom., Od., x, 554; cf. MGr., terrace), house-top: ἐπὶ τ. δῶμα, Luc 5:19, Actes 10:9; ἐπὶ τ. δώματος, -άτων, Matthieu 10:27 24:17, Marc 13:15, Luc 12:3 17:31.†

G1431.def:
δωρεά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(δίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly (-άν) for חִנָּם, as Genèse 29:15 ;] 
a gift: Actes 11:17, Romains 5:15, Hébreux 6:4; δ. τ. θεοῦ, Jean 4:10, Actes 8:20; τ. Χριστοῦ, Éphésiens 4:7; τ. πνεύματος, Actes 2:38 10:45; τ. δικαιοσύνης, Romains 5:17; τ. χάριτος, Éphésiens 3:7; ἀνεκδιηγήτὶῳ δ., 2 Corinthiens 9:15. Acc, δωρεάν, adverbially (as frequently in LXX), 
__(a) freely, as a gift: Matthieu 10:8, Romains 3:24, 2 Corinthiens 11:7, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:8, Apocalypse 21:6 22:17; 
__(b) in vain, uselessly: (Jean 15:25 LXX) Galates 2:21.†
SYN.: see: δόμα

G1432.def:
δωρεάν, see: δωρεά.
δωρεά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(δίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly (-άν) for חִנָּם, as Genèse 29:15 ;] 
a gift: Actes 11:17, Romains 5:15, Hébreux 6:4; δ. τ. θεοῦ, Jean 4:10, Actes 8:20; τ. Χριστοῦ, Éphésiens 4:7; τ. πνεύματος, Actes 2:38 10:45; τ. δικαιοσύνης, Romains 5:17; τ. χάριτος, Éphésiens 3:7; ἀνεκδιηγήτὶῳ δ., 2 Corinthiens 9:15. Acc, δωρεάν, adverbially (as frequently in LXX), 
__(a) freely, as a gift: Matthieu 10:8, Romains 3:24, 2 Corinthiens 11:7, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:8, Apocalypse 21:6 22:17; 
__(b) in vain, uselessly: (Jean 15:25 LXX) Galates 2:21.†
SYN.: see: δόμα

G1433.def:
δωρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Genèse 30:20 (זָבַד), Esther 8:1, Proverbes 4:2 (נָתַן), Lévitique 7:15 (קׇרְבָּן), 1Es.1:7 Esther 8:14 Esther 8:55, Sir.7:25 * ;] 
to present, bestow. As depon. (with same sense), -Ιομαι,.-οίμαι: Marc 15:45, 2 Pierre 1:3-4.† 
SYN.: δίδωμι, q.v

G1434.def:
δώρημα, -τος, τό
(δωρέω), [in LXX: Sir.31:18 (Sir.34:18)* ;] 
a gift, boon: Romains 5:16, Jacques 1:17.†
SYN.: see: δόμα

G1435.def:
δῶρον, -ου, τό
(δίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly for קׇרְבָּן, also for מִנְחָה, etc. ;] 
a gift, present: Matthieu 2:11, Apocalypse 11:10; of gifts and sacrifices to God, Matthieu 5:23-24 8:4 15:5 23:18-19, Marc 7:11, Luc 21:1, 4, Hébreux 5:1 8:3-4 9:9 11:4; δ. θεοῦ, Éphésiens 2:8.†
SYN.: see word δόμα

G1436.def:
ἔα, 
interj., 
expressing surprise, indignation, fear (in cl. chiefly in poët.), ah! ha!: Luc 4:34.†

G1439.def:
ἐάω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX for רפה hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to let, permit: with accusative, with inf., with accusative and inf. (M, Pr., 205): Matthieu 24:43, Luc 4:41 22:51, Actes 14:16; 16.7, 19:30 23.32 27:32 28:4 , 1 Corinthiens 10:13. 
__2. to let alone, leave: ἀγκύρας, Actes 27:40 (cf. προσ-εάω).
†

G1440.def:
ἑβδομήκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl. 
(ἑπτά), 
seventy: Luc 10:1, 17 Actes 7:14 23:23 27:37.†

G1441.def:
ἑβδομηκοντάκις, adv., 
[in LXX for שִׁבְעִים, Genèse 4:24 * ;] 
seventy times: ἑ. ἑπτά, seventy times seven, Matthieu 18:22 (R, txt., ICC, in l.), or seventy-seven times (R, mg.; cf. M, Pr., 98; WM, 314; Meyer, in l.).†

G1442.def:
ἕβδομος, -η, -ον 
(ἑπτὰ), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁבִיעִי ;] 
seventh: Jean 4:52, Hébreux 4:4" (LXX), Ju 14, Apocalypse 8:1 10:7 11:15 16:17 21:20.†

G1443.def:
Ἔβερ (Rec. Ἐβέρ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. עֵבֶר, Genèse 10:24), 
Eber (OT, Heber): Luc 3:35.†

G1445.def:
Ἑβραῖος (WH, Ἐβ-), -α, -ον (Aram, עִבְרַי), as subst., ὁ Ἑ., 
[in LXX for עֵבֶר, עִבְרִי ;] 
a Hebrew. 
__1. In OT, of Israelites in contrast with those of another race (Genèse 14:13, Exode 1:15, Deutéronome 15:12, al.). 
__2. In NT as the correlative of Ἑλληνιστής, a Jew who had adopted, in greater or less degree, Greek culture and Greek language. The distinction was not merely linguistic (DB, ii, 325); as far as it was so, Συριστής would be a more correct Greek term for the Jew of Semitic speech (see: Ἑβραΐς, and cf. Dalman, Words, 7): Actes 6:1, 2 Corinthiens 11:22, Philippiens 3:5.
†

G1446.def:
Ἑβραΐς (WH, Ἐβ-), -ίδος (Aram. עִבְרַי), peculiar form of Ἑβραϊκός, 
[in LXX, ἡ Ἑ. φωνή, 4Ma.12:7 16:15 * ;] 
in NT, ἡ Ἑ. διάλεκτος, Hebrew, i.e. the Aramaic vernacular of Palestine: Actes 21:40 22:2 26:14.†

G1447.def:
Ἑβραϊστί (WH, Ἐβ-), adv., 
[in LXX: Si prol. 13 * ;] 
in Hebrew: Apocalypse 9:11; elsewhere, in Aramaic (see supr.): Jean 5:2 19:13, 17, 20 20:16, Apocalypse 16:16.†

G1448.def:
ἐγγίζω (ἐγγύς). 
[in LXX for נגשׁ, קרב, etc. ;] 
__1. trans., to bring near: Genèse 48:10, Ésaïe 5:8. 
__2. Intrans., to come near: absol., Matthieu 26:46, Marc 14:42, Luc 18:40 19:41 21:20, 28 24:15, Actes 21:33 23:15; with adv., ὅπου, Luc 12:33; with dative, Luc 7:12 15:1, Luke.15.25 22:47, Actes 9:3 10:9 22:6; τ. θεῷ, Hébreux 7:19, Jacques 4:8; before εἰς, Matthieu 21:1, Marc 11:1, Luc 18:35 19:29 24:28; πρός, with dative, Luc 19:37; μέχρι θανάτου, Philippiens 2:30; of time, ὥρα, Matthieu 26:45; ἡμέρα, Romains 13:12, Hébreux 10:25; καιρός, Matthieu 21:34, Luc 21:8; χρόνος, Actes 7:17; ἑορτή, Luc 22:1; παρουσία, Jacques 5:8; τέλος, 1 Pierre 4:7; ἐρήμωσις, Luc 21:20; ἀπολύτρωσις, Luc 21:28; ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία (for similar expressions in Targ., see Dalman, 106), Matthieu 3:2 4:17 10:7 Marc 1:15, Luc 10:9 (ἐφ ̓ ὑμᾶς) 10:11 (cf. προσ-εγγίζω), and see Cremer, 224).
†

G1449.def:
1. to mark in or on, to paint on , (Herdotus Historicus) 
2. to inscribe, write in or on , (Herdotus Historicus):—;Pass., ἐγγεγραμμένος τι having something written on it, (Sophocles Tragicus); so Virgil flores inscripti nomina. 
3. to enter in the public register , ἐγγρ. τὸν υἱὸν εἰς ἄνδρας (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass., εἰς τοὺς δημότας ἐγγραφῆναι (Demosthenes Orator) 
4. to enter on the judge's list, to indict , (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

G1450.def:
ἔγγυος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ, 
[in LXX: Sir.29:15, 16 2Ma.10:28 * ;] 
a surety: Hébreux 7:22 (exx. from π., see MM, Exp., xi; cf. Cremer, 222).†

G1451.def:
ἐγγύς, adv., 
[in LXX chiefly for קָרוֹב ;] 
near; 
__1. of place: Jean 19:20, 42; as prep. with genitive (M, Pr., 99), Luc 19:11, Jean 3:23 6:19, 23 11:18, 54, Actes 1:12; with dative, Actes 9:38 27:8; superl., ἔγγιστα, Marc 6:36, WH, mg.; metaphorically, ֹοἱ ἐ., opposite to οἱ μακράν, Éphésiens 2:17; ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Éphésiens 2:13; ἐ. σου τὸ ῥῆμα, Romains 10:8 (LXX). 
__2. Of time: Matthieu 24:32 26:18, Marc 13:28, 29 Luc 21:30, 31 Jean 2:13 6:4 7:2 11:55, Apocalypse 1:3 22:10; ὁ κύριος ἐ., Philippiens 4:5; before ἐπὶ θύραις, Matthieu 24:33; compar., ἐγγύτερον (neut. of adj. -ος, used adverbially), Romains 13:11 (cf. R, txt.); as prep. with genitive, ἐ. κατάρας, Hébreux 6:8; ἀφανισμοῦ, Hébreux 8:13 (cf. Cremer, 223).
†

G1452.def:
ἐγγύτερος, see: ἐγγύς. 
ἐγγύς, adv., 
[in LXX chiefly for קָרוֹב ;] 
near; 
__1. of place: Jean 19:20, 42; as prep. with genitive (M, Pr., 99), Luc 19:11, Jean 3:23 6:19, 23 11:18, 54, Actes 1:12; with dative, Actes 9:38 27:8; superl., ἔγγιστα, Marc 6:36, WH, mg.; metaphorically, ֹοἱ ἐ., opposite to οἱ μακράν, Éphésiens 2:17; ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Éphésiens 2:13; ἐ. σου τὸ ῥῆμα, Romains 10:8 (LXX). 
__2. Of time: Matthieu 24:32 26:18, Marc 13:28, 29 Luc 21:30, 31 Jean 2:13 6:4 7:2 11:55, Apocalypse 1:3 22:10; ὁ κύριος ἐ., Philippiens 4:5; before ἐπὶ θύραις, Matthieu 24:33; compar., ἐγγύτερον (neut. of adj. -ος, used adverbially), Romains 13:11 (cf. R, txt.); as prep. with genitive, ἐ. κατάρας, Hébreux 6:8; ἀφανισμοῦ, Hébreux 8:13 (cf. Cremer, 223).
†

G1453.def:
ἐγείρω, [in LXX for קוּם, etc. ;] trans. (imperat. ἔγειρε used intransitively, Matthieu 9:5, Marc 2:11, al.); 
__1. to awaken, arouse from sleep: Marc 4:38, Actes 12:7; metaphorically, of spiritual awakening, Romains 13:11 (pass.), Éphésiens 5:14; pass., to be aroused, wake up: Matthieu 25:7, Marc 4:27; ἀπὸ τ. ὕπνου, Matthieu 1:24. 
__2. Freq. in NT, to raise from the dead: νεκρούς, Jean 5:21, Actes 26:8, 2 Corinthiens 1:9; ἐκ νεκρῶν, Jean 12:1, Actes 3:15, Romains 8:11, al.; pass., rise from death: Matthieu 11:5, Luc 7:22, Jean 2:22, Romains 6:9, al.; ἀπὸ τ. νεκρῶν, Matthieu 14:2, al. 
__3. In late Gk., 
__(a) to raise, from sitting, lying, sickness; mid. and pass., to rise: Matthieu 9:5, 7 Marc 1:31 9:27 10:49, al.; redundant, like Heb. קוּם, Matthieu 2:15 9:19, Apocalypse 11:1 (see Dalman, 23f.); 
__(b) to raise up, cause to appear: Actes 13:22 (cf. Juges 2:18); τέκνα, Matthieu 3:9; pass., to appear: Matthieu 11:11, Marc 13:22, al. 
__4. to rouse, stir up; pass., to rise against: Matthieu 24:7, Marc 13:8. 
__5. Of buildings, to raise: τ. ναόν, Jean 2:19, 20 (cf . Deutéronome 16:22, Sir.49:13); (cf. δι-, ἐξ-, συν-εγείρω, and V. Cremer, 224).

G1454.def:
ἔγερσις, -εως, ἡ (ἐγείρω, -ομαι)), 
[in LXX: Juges 7:19, Psa.138 (139)2 (קוּם), I Esther 5:62 * ;] 
__1. a rousing (Plat.). 
__2. a rising (Ps, l.with): from death, Matthieu 27:53.
†

G1455.def:
ἐνκάθετος (Rec. ἐγκ-), -αν 
(ἐγκαθίημι), [in LXX: Job 31:9 (אָרַב), Job 19:12 * ;] 
suborned to lie in wait, lying in wait: as subst., Luc 20:20.†

G1456.def:
ἐγκαίνια, see: ἐνκ- 
ἐνκαίνια (Rec. ἐγκ-), -ων, τά (ἐν, καινός), 
[in LXX for HSjrj, II Esther 6:16, 17, Néhémie 12:27, Da TH 3:2 (and cf. ἐγκαινισμός, Nombres 7:10, al., -ισις, Nombres 7:88) *;] 
dedication (anniversary of the cleansing of the Temple from the defilements of Antiochus Epiphanes) : Jean 10:22.†

G1457.def:

G1459.def:
ἐγκαταλείπω, 
[in LXX chiefly for עזב ;] 
__1. to leave behind: ἡμῖν σπέρμα, Romains 9:29 (LXX). 
__2. to abandon, desert, forsake: with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 27:46 (LXX), Marc 15:34 (ib.), Actes 2:27 (LXX) (WH, ἐνκ-), 2 Timothée 4:10, 16 Hébreux 13:5" (LXX) ; τ. ἐπισυναγωγήν (cf. MM, Exp., xi), Hébreux 10:25. Pass., Actes 2:31 (WH, ἐνκ-), 2 Corinthiens 4:9.

G1460.def:
ἐγκατοικέω, see: ἐνκ-.

to dwell among: before ἐν, 2 Pierre 2:8.†

G1461.def:
ἐγκεντρίζω, see: ἐνκ-.
ἐν-κεντρίζω (Rec. ἐγρ-, see: ἐν; κεντρίζω, to graft), 
[in LXX: Wis.16:11 *;] 
to ingraft, graft in. figuratively, with accusative of person(s), Romains 11:17,19,23,24.†

G1462.def:
ἔγκλημα -τος, τό 
(ἐγκαλέω), 
an accusation, charge: Actes 23:29 25:16 (Cremer, 743).†

G1463.def:
ἐγκομβόομαι, -οῦμαι 
(κόμβος, a knot, whence ἐγκόμβωμα, a garment tied on over others, used especially of a frock or apron worn by slaves), 
to put on oneself, as a garment, gird on: ἀλλήλοις τ. ταπεινοφροσύνην (as for service, RV, cf. Thayer, see word, but cf. also ICC, in l.), 1 Pierre 5:5.†

G1466.def:
ἐγκράτεια, -ας, ἡ (-ἐγκρατής), 
[in LXX: Sir.18:15, 30 4Ma.5:34 * ;] 
__1. prop., mastery, control. 
__2. (sc. ἑαθτοῦ) self-control: Actes 24:25, Galates 5:23, 2 Pierre 1:6 (see DB, iv, 558b 695a; Page on Ac, l.with).
†

G1467.def:
ἐγκρατεύομαι, depon., 
[in LXX for אפק, Genèse 43:31, 1 Rois 13:12, Esther 5:10 א 3 * ;] 
to exercise self-control: 1 Corinthiens 7:9; with accusative, πάντα (see Bl., 91), 1 Corinthiens 9:25.†

G1468.def:
ἐγκρατής, -ές 
(κράτος), [in LXX: Wis.8:20, Sir.6:27 15:1 26:15 27:30, al. ;] 
__1. strong, powerful. 
__2. C. genitive of thing(s), master of, hence, 
__3. (sc. ἑαυτοῦ), self -controlled, exercising self-control: Tite 1:8.

G1469.def:
ἐγ-κρίνω, see: ἐνκ-.

to reckon among : ἑαυτούς, 2 Corinthiens 10:12.†

G1470.def:
ἐγ-κρύπτω, 
[in LXX for טמן, etc. ;] 
to conceal in: with accusative, before εἰς, Matthieu 13:33.†

G1471.def:
ἔγκυος, see: ἐνκ-.
ἔνκυoς (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν), -ον 
(κύω, to conceive), [in LXX: Sir.42:10 * ;] 
pregnant, big with child : Luc 2:5.†

G1472.def:
ἐγχρίω, 
[in LXX: Jérémie 4:30 (קרע). Tob.2:10 6:8 11:7 * ;] 
to rub in, anoint: mid., with dupl. accusative, Apocalypse 3:18.†

G1473.def:
ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, 
of person(s) pron. 
I. 
__(a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in Matthieu 3:11, Marc 1:8, Luc 3:16, al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as Matthieu 10:16, Jean 10:17; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. 1 Rois 3:8), Actes 9:10; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, Jean 1:23 (LXX), Actes 7:32 (LXX). 
__(b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, Jean 14:20; μου τ. λόγους, Matthieu 7:24; ὀπίσω μου, Matthieu 3:11; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, Apocalypse 5:5; also with the prep. πρός, as Marc 9:19, al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as Luc 10:16, Jean 7:23, Marc 14:7, al. 
__(with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, Matthieu 2:6; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, Marc 9:24. 
__(d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, Juges 11:12, al.), i.e. what have we in common: Matthieu 8:29, Marc 1:24, 5:7, Luc 8:28, Jean 2:4; τί γάρ μοι, 1 Corinthiens 5:2. 
__(e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.).
__(f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), and I, even I, I also: Matthieu 2:8, Luc 2:48, Jean 6:56, Romains 3:7, 1 Corinthiens 7:40, al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, both . . . and, Jean 7:28.

G1474.def:
ἐδαφίζω (ἔδαφος) 
[in LXX chiefly for רטשׁ pu. ;] 
__1. to beat level like a threshing floor (Theophr.). 
__2. to dash to the ground (Field, Notes, 74): Luc 19:44 (cf. Psa.136(137):9, Osée 14:1).
†

G1475.def:
ἔδαφος, -εος (-ους), τό, 
[in LXX for עָפָר, קַרְקע, etc. ;] 
bottom, pavement, ground: Actes 22:7.†

G1476.def:
ἑδραῖος, -ον (ἕδρα, a seat), [in Sm.: Ps 32 (33):14, al. ;]

__2. steadfast, firm; metaphorically, of moral fixity: 1 Corinthiens 7:37 15:58, Colossiens 1:23.
†

G1477.def:

(ἑδραῖος),

G1478.def:
Ἑζεκίας (Rec. Ἐζ-), -ου, ὁ (Heb. חִזְקִיָּה, strength of Jehovah), 
Hezekiah, King of Judah: Matthieu 1:9, 10.†

G1479.def:
ἐθελο-θρησκία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ, 
self-imposed worship: Colossiens 2:23 (eccl.; cf. DB, iv, 923a; Cremer, 733).†

G1480.def:
ἐθίζω,

G1481.def:

(ἔθνος, ἄρχω), [in LXX: 1Ma.14:47 15:1, 2 * ;]

G1482.def:
ἐθνικός, -ή, -όν, [in Al.: Lévitique 21:7 * ;] 
__1. national (Polyb.). 
__2. foreign (gramm.); in NT, as subst., ὁ ἐ., the Gentile (the adj. "describes character rather than mere position"; cf. ἔθνος, and see Cremer, 228): Matthieu 5:47 6:7 18:17, 3Jo.7.
†

G1483.def:
ἐθνικῶς, 
adv., 
in Gentile fashion: Galates 2:14.†

G1484.def:
ἔθνος, -ους, τό, 
[in LXX chiefly for עַם ,גּוֹי ;] 
__1. a multitude, a company, whether of beasts or men (Hom.). 
__2. a nation, people: Matthieu 21:43 24:7, Marc 13:8, Luc 22:25, Actes 10:35, al.; in sing., of the Jewish people, Luc 7:5 23:2, Jean 11:48, 50-53 18:35, Actes 10:22 24:3, 10 26:4 28:19.

G1485.def:
ἔθος, -εος (-ους), τό 
(ἔθω), [in LXX: Wis.14:16, Da TH Bel 15, 1Ma.10:89, 2Ma.11:25 13:4, 4Ma.18:5 א R* ;] 
habit, custom; Luc 22:39, Jean 19:40, Actes 16:21 25:16, Hébreux 10:25; in Luc 1:9 Actes 6:14 15:1 21:21 26:3 28:17, almost in the narrower sense of law (Deiss., BS, 251 f.).†

[in LXX: Nombres 24:1 (כְּפַעַם־בְּפַעַם), Dan LXX Su 13, Sir.37:14, 4Ma.1:12 * ;]

G1487G.def:
εἰ, 
conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions. 
__I. Conditional, if; 
__1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; 
__(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Matthieu 11:14, Romains 8:25, al.; before imperat., Marc 4:23 9:22, Jean 15:18, 1 Corinthiens 7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luc 16:31, Romains 8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Matthieu 12:26, Romains 4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luc 17:6, Jean 8:39; before quæst., Matthieu 6:23, Jean 5:47 7:23 8:46, 1 Pierre 2:20; 
__(b) fut.: Matthieu 26:33, 1 Pierre 2:20; 
__(with) pf.: Jean 11:12, Romains 6:5, al.; 
__(d) aor.: Luc 16:11 19:8, Jean 13:32, 18:23, Apocalypse 20:15, al. 
__2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Matthieu 12:28, Jean 7:4, Romains 5:17, al. 
__3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 
__4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Marc 15:44, 1 Jean 3:13, al. 
__5. C. indic., as in LXX (Nombres 14:3o, 1 Rois 14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Marc 8:12, Hébreux 3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 
__6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Actes 24:19 27:39, 1 Corinthiens 14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17. 
__II. Interrogative, if, whether. 
__1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Matthieu 26:63, Marc 15:36, Actes 19:2, 2 Corinthiens 13:5, al.; fut., Marc 3:2, Actes 8:22, al.; aor., Marc 15:44, 1 Corinthiens 1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Philippiens 3:12. 
__2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Genèse 17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Marc 8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luc 13:23, 22:49, Actes 19:2, al.
__III. With other particles. 
__1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε. 
__2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: Luc 11:18; but even if, 1 Corinthiens 4:7, 2 Corinthiens 4:3 11:16. 
__3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: Marc 2:21, 22 Jean 14:2, Apocalypse 2:5, al. 
__4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: Marc 14:29, Luc 11:8, 1 Corinthiens 7:21, 2 Corinthiens 4:16, Philippiens 2:17, al. 
__5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί 
__6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: Matthieu 24:22, Marc 2:26 6:5, Jean 9:33, 1 Corinthiens 7:17 (only), Galates 1:19 (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), 1 Corinthiens 14:5 15:2, 1 Timothée 5:19. 
__7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely (Eze.33:27, al.): Hébreux 6:14. 
__8. εἴ πως, if haply: Actes 27:12, Romains 1:10. 
__9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; Romains 12:6-8, 1 Corinthiens 3:22 13:8, al.
